snippet.title: Symbiosis Gameplay Trailer | Marathon
snippet.description:
Get a taste of Marathon's evolution with Symbiosis, coming Dec 8, 2026. Introducing the PvE Expedition mode; Deathmatch, our PvP beta; the new Runner Shell Bishop; and more. 

Play Marathon now:  
PlayStation 5: https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/marathon/ 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3065800/Marathon/ 
XBOX Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/marathon-standard-edition/9p8mgmxndv9b 

Follow Marathon:  
Website: https://www.marathonthegame.com/  
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@marathonthegame 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/marathonthegame 
Twitter: https://x.com/marathonthegame  
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/marathonthegame.bungie.net 
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/marathonthegame 

Explore the lost colony of Tau Ceti IV, scavenging valuable loot in a high-stakes survival first person shooter from the creators of Halo and Destiny.  

Drop in to the dark sci-fi world of Marathon filled with rival players, enemy forces, and unpredictable dangers. Scavenge its maps alone or with a crew, then fight your way to success in tense, high-stakes PvP and PvE battles.
